name: the summary button bails out instead of re-anchoring
why: The reported defect, restored exactly. .mb-row-count-stat is removed and re-created on every filter, and _artCreateOrUpdateToggleButton() copes by re-deriving its position from the LIVE stat every call. Bailing out on "already exists" opts this button out of that, so a filter leaves it between the heading text and the stat while the rest of the run moves on. The test asserts ORDER, not existence — the button never disappeared, so an existence check passed throughout the bug.

name: the re-anchor call site is dropped from the already-present path
why: Re-anchoring is only reachable because _artCreateOrUpdateRetryButton() now calls it BEFORE its own early return. Putting the call back inside the just-created branch alone makes it run exactly once per page, which is the state the bug was reported in.
